title: Show authoritative Paper Persona readiness instead of false 0-of-5 onboarding

root_cause.observed_defect: PersonaDetail rendered PersonaReadinessCard with only the flat Persona DTO from GET /bff/personas/{id} instead of GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{id}. derivePersonaReadiness only accepted paper_owner/live_owner/active as active lifecycles (rejecting paper_running), required approval.state === 'approved' (failing on owner decisions with state: 'decided' and outcome: 'approved'), did not cross-verify provisioning_authoritative_readback when BFF deploymentPlans/approvals sub-surfaces were empty, synthesized UI health status/reasons, and rendered missing/unavailable sub-surfaces as 'not created' (未建立).
repair_summary: Added getPersonaManagement(id) in src/lib/bff-v1/personas.ts targeting GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{id} and wired PersonaDetail.tsx to pass the authoritative management envelope and unavailability state to PersonaReadinessCard.

Updated derivePersonaReadiness in src/management/lib/personaReadiness.ts to recognize canonical active lifecycles (including paper_running and paper_active), cross-verify authoritative owner readback alongside active capital bindings and runtime bindings, never infer 5/5 readiness from paper_running or flat Persona IDs alone, preserve unavailable stage status when surfaces are missing/unavailable instead of falsely rendering not_created, reflect paused/retired runtime status, and use BFF health status/reasons directly without UI synthesis.
Updated PersonaReadinessCard.tsx and zh-TW/en-US locales to display Paper runtime status with runtime ID on 5/5 Paper personas and distinct unavailable/paused/retired stage labels.
